powerSaving: The phone was found in Power saving (settings global low_power = 1) on the evening of 2026-11-17: the big cores were capped at 1.77 GHz and, sampled every 100 ms through /proc, Milion's main thread (Dart runs on it) sat on the little cores for the last third of IX's reveal. When the mode was switched on is not recorded, so the P12 pass's IX and VI runs above were probably taken in it. The owner switched it off for the runs marked so; the bench does not change the phone's settings. Budgets are measured with Power saving off from now on, and each run names the mode.
